signal_rationale: WHO 23 October 2026 confirmed Nigeria's imported case and Kenya's traced cluster, while DRC contact-follow-up, community deaths and vaccine trial launch provide new institutional and socioeconomic evidence.
key_constraints: no approved Bundibugyo vaccine or specific therapy

producer_checks.visual_signature: Two quantitative charts, table, map and flow in both languages, identical chart data.

en.title: Ebola crosses borders while eastern Congo's response capacity remains the decisive constraint
en.deck: WHO documents 9,704 DRC cases and imported cases in Kenya and Nigeria; contact tracing, essential services and financing delivery shape the socioeconomic consequences.
en.regime: Imported cases without documented generalized cross-border spread, amid sustained DRC transmission and uneven response coverage.
en.key_risk: Unlinked clusters and interruptions to routine care outpace tracing and delivered response capacity.
watch: Unlinked cases in Kenya or Nigeria
